title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Carry-over and Expiry of Unused Callouts
content:
Unused callouts on a Keyturn Roadside Assistance subscription carry into the next term only on the
plans that allow it, and no more than the plan's roll-over ceiling carries however many are left; the
rest simply lapse at the end of the term.

A carried callout expires the plan's expiry period in whole calendar days from the day it was granted,
and an expired callout is not restored on request.

### The carry-over clause restated

Where the plan does not allow carry-over, nothing carries and everything unused lapses at the end of
the term. Where the plan does allow it, the number that carries is the smaller of the callouts standing
unused and the plan's roll-over ceiling; where more stand unused than the ceiling allows, the ceiling is
what carries and the remainder lapses at the end of the term.

### The expiry clock

The expiry period is counted in whole calendar days from the day the callout was granted. It is not
counted from the day the callout carried into the new term, so a carried callout brings with it the
days that have already run against its expiry period rather than beginning its period afresh. Once the
period has run the callout is expired, and an expired callout is not restored on request.
